name: Minecraft: Aether Legends
summary: The Aether Minecraft: Java Edition mod reimagined for Bedrock Edition as an official dynamic world. Build the Aether portal and step into a new dimension in the sky. Befriend new creatures, explore ancient structures, and fight monsters for legendary items. Forge new Aether tools, weapons and armor. Unlock powers like double-jump, glide and more. Face the Slider, Valkyrie Queen and Karthuul.
